messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled staged rollout started for service inference v3.2.4 -> traffic metering 20% -> 50% over 30m in us-east-1. Monitoring: latency (p95/p99), 5xx, KV cache hit. Runbook: https://redwood.in/r/runbooks/staged-shift
context: cfg: target=50, step=10, step_interval=5m, regions=[us-east-1, eu-west-1]
Commands: `redwoodctl rollout status 2217654321`

maria: Seeing a p95 spike from ~120ms -> 220ms on the first 20% step in us-east-1, heatmap shows microburst around 14:04 UTC. No 5xxs yet but traces show longer KV lookups. Suggest pause and inspect :eyes:

kevin: Can you paste the pod ids + tails of the logs? Also what's the KV cache hit rate by pod? need exact numbers before deciding.

shreya: +1 to hold. Could be cold-start/kv-warmup. Proposal: pause at 20%, increase step_interval -> 10m, and cap at 30% until we confirm stable latency.

deploy-bot: Pausing rollout per request. Rollout state: PAUSED at 20% in us-east-1. To resume: `redwoodctl rollout resume 2217654321`. To rollback: `redwoodctl rollout rollback 2217654321 --to v3.2.3`

luis: PM note — customer-facing canary tests running in eu-west are green. If we pin EU traffic to older model we need to coordinate with support and update release notes.

maria: I initiated a targeted manual rollback in us-east-1 to v3.2.3: `redwoodctl deploy --service inference --version v3.2.3 --region us-east-1 --force`. Post-rollback the 5xxs returned to baseline and p95 went back to ~125ms. Recommend keep eu-west untouched and hold global shift.

kevin: +1 to keep eu-west. I'll update release notes and open follow-up ticket RINF-2047 for investigation and mitigations.

shreya: Also recommend we add a temporary throttle policy to metering to prevent quick re-advances. Suggest max_step=10 and require 2 consecutive stable windows (10m each) with <10% p95 delta before next step.

deploy-bot: Update: rollout remains PAUSED at 20% in us-east-1. eu-west-1 currently at 20% and unchanged. Tagging @support @oncall for visibility.

maria: Confirming eu-west remains on v3.2.4 for now — support reports no customer impact. I'll monitor dashboards for 30m and then propose a controlled retry (warmup + smaller step).

kevin: Action items captured: 1) lock percent metering to 20% across regions, 2) add throttle rule, 3) open postmortem (RINF-2047). I'll own the release notes update.

shreya: ack. I'll run a warmup job to prefill KV cache in us-east-1 before any retry and coordinate with infra to increase prefetch concurrency.

maria: Good plan. Marking this thread tracking the hold/rollback decision. Will reopen if metrics deviate. :white_check_mark:
